Create My Service Canada Account - Canada.ca

content.text:
You can log in to **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)** here:

**Official Canada.ca page:** ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

On that page, choose one of these sign-in options:

- **Interac® Sign-In Partner** — sign in using participating online banking credentials  
- **GCKey** — sign in with a Government of Canada username/password  
- **Provincial sign-in** — available for **BC** and **Alberta** residents only ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/province.html?utm_source=openai))

If you don’t have an account yet, use the **Create a My Service Canada Account** page; you must be at least 12 and use the account only for yourself. ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/registration.html?utm_source=openai))

**Safety tip:** don’t use links from emails/texts. Start from the official Canada.ca page, and don’t bookmark secure pages after you’re signed in.
